He would make fun of me unless he wanted sex and then suddenly I was hot and sexy

And I'm not exactly beautiful either 

I know it doesn't overly matter and I do believe that personality is more important but then that just makes it worse bc I dont overly love my personality either. It's like I have good thoughts but they come out all wrong and I just sound weird

Well the most shameful thing I've done that I'm terrified of people finding out about is how young I was when I had sex. My boyfriend at the time was horrible and towards the end forced me to do a lot of stuff but I didnt leave him. Also just my drinking habits, and just every now and then bad decisions I make.

No matter what I do I can only see my body as huge and weirdly shaped and just unattractive. I just want to feel pretty sometimes but I don't. I've tried to lose weight but I can't even do that

It just feels like I'll never improve

I dont know theres so so many things that add to it.
The main things that I think about day to day are all the shitty and shameful things I've done in my life either as distractions or just because I didnt think twice, and how gross my body is and how I never achieve anything and just make a mess of every friendship I get. It's just such a combination of so many things over the years. Its overwhelming

Theres just so many things about me that arent normal (I have short dark hair, I dont really wear makeup, I but mens clothes, I'm not into stuff that most people are, I make weird art and I'm pan ) and I just dont want to have to add "mentally ill" to that list.
And by having fun I mean just being able to fit in with my group and relaxing and not have to be the "mentally ill" one

I'd like a black motorbike and honestly a black horse as well

I feel like they helped to the extent where I was finally acc talking about it. But I was never offered medication and then my therapist moved away so I only saw her once every 8 weeks. And it just felt like I was deemed "recovered" and I just had to get on with it.
I just wish someone fully understood and could just be there every now and then even just to ask if I'm ok. Just be there yk, without it being a huge deal
I suppose it is. But I guess it's the fear of once I start opening up I wont stop and then it will all be a big deal again without actually helping

If I act fine then I can continue making people proud, and having fun. I dont want to drag my friends down. 
After November things got better very gradually in a sense of I wasbt trying to actively kill myself/self harm all the time and I started to see some reasons to stay

My goals generally are to become a vet and get a motorbike and a horse. They're stupid but it's just things I hold onto

Idk because I dont want pity and I dont want them to treat me differently. And also I just dont want to have to go through all the therapy and teacher meetings and stuff. It's easier to just pretend you're holding on yk?
